about: Order: (1) all of Punjab; (2) the district holding each state or union territory capital; (3) every other district, state by state. Names are the portal's own (geoTaggingZpReport.do, read November 2026). Capitals left out because their district has no gram panchayat with geotagged works on the portal in plan years 2023-2024 to 2026-2027: Chandigarh (also capital of Punjab and Haryana), Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Imphal West, and the capitals of Jammu And Kashmir, Ladakh, Lakshadweep, Andaman And Nicobar Islands, The Dadra And Nagar Haveli And Daman And Diu, Meghalaya, Nagaland and Puducherry. Those last ten states and union territories showed a count of 0 in all four plan years and are not in the plan; add them back if the state report shows activities. Each unit runs every plan year the report page offers. See collector/schemes/egramswaraj.py.
